mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals a weakening labor market, which typically precedes an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5pp in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy in the face of inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL is increasing, and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy with increased consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases, and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a slowing economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases during a monetary tightening cycle and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
